name: Neon Intercept
summary:
Neon Intercept is a classic arcade defence game rebuilt for VR. A glowing city floats at table height in front of you, and the night sky above it fills with missiles, drones and bombers. Your hands are the city's two batteries: point, pull the trigger and an interceptor streaks up and bursts into a neon ring. Anything inside it is gone, and its blast can catch the next one. Big chains score big.
